articles.summary: First Horizon Bank (NYSE: FHN) (or "First Horizon") is pleased to announce that Dwayne "DJ" Mercadel has joined the First Horizon team as its Gulf States Retail Banking Executive covering Texas and Louisiana. He brings more than 20 years of experience as an operational leader in retail banking, talent development and service excellence. articles.summary: First Horizon Bank (NYSE: FHN) (or "First Horizon") today announced a partnership with Greenlight Financial Technology, Inc. ("Greenlight") to give First Horizon clients and their families access to Greenlight's family financial app and safety tools. The platform combines debit cards, money management tools and financial education for kids and teens with resources that help parents and caregivers manage family finances. Greenlight teaches kids and teens how to build healthy money habits by giving them hands-on tools to learn how to earn, save, spend and manage money. Parents and caregivers get greater visibility and control over how their children use and learn about money, and can monitor and protect senior loved ones from financial fraud and theft . Eligible clients who connect a First Horizon account as their funding source can access Greenlight's Select subscription at no cost. Enhanced Greenlight plans are available at a discount for additional features and family protection.
articles.title: First Horizon Bank and Greenlight Bring Family Financial Tools to Kids and Teens

articles.summary: First Horizon Corporation (NYSE: FHN) (or "First Horizon") today reported financial results for the third quarter of a net loss available to common shareholders of $(94) million or loss per share of $(0.20). These results reflect the impact of strategic actions to further align the balance sheet with the Company's growth priorities. During the quarter, the Company began evaluating the possibility of selling ~$4.5 billion of select lower yielding consumer mortgages and, in early October, entered into an agreement to sell these mortgages. This transaction will be accretive to earnings on a go forward basis and will provide balance sheet flexibility to support future loan growth. The transaction is expected to settle early in the fourth quarter. Excluding notable items, adjusted earnings per share for third quarter 2026 was $0.53, down $0.01 from second quarter 2026 and up $0.02 from third quarter 2025.
